caption: The drawing features a rectangular area filled with a repeating geometric pattern. The main colors used are dark blue, beige, and light coral pink. The pattern consists of a grid of horizontal and vertical lines forming rectangles and squares, with alternating bands of color. Wide horizontal bands of coral pink intersect with vertical bands of beige, forming a plaid or checkered effect, with both bands overlaid on a densely patterned blue background. The blue areas contain a series of small beige rectangular marks arranged in horizontal lines. The intersecting bands create a sense of depth due to their overlapping arrangement, and the entire patterned section is centered on a light beige background with rough, uneven edges. There is a small signature in the lower right corner.
title: Coverlet
